claim: In Q4 2025, Apple's revenue came in at $165.3 billion or more.
summary: Without browsing tools no authoritative filing (10-Q, 8-K, earnings release) can be cited for Apple's Q4 2025 revenue as of knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04. Calendar Q4 2025 (Apple fiscal Q1 2026) would typically be reported in early Feb 2026 after the cutoff, so it cannot be verified from internal knowledge alone, and the fiscal vs calendar quarter ambiguity prevents establishing the $165.3B+ assertion.

sub_claims.text: Apple's revenue in Q4 2025 was greater than or equal to $165.3 billion
sub_claims.stated_text: Apple's revenue came in at $165.3 billion or more in Q4 2025
sub_claims.note: No tool access to retrieve Apple's earnings release or SEC filing; knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 predates expected reporting for calendar Q4 2025 (Apple fiscal Q1 2026), and fiscal Q4 2025 vs calendar Q4 2025 interpretation is ambiguous, so no evidence IDs can be cited to support or contradict.
